# devmy command catalog

Every brick command accepts `--var key=value` (repeatable), `--[no-]interactive` and `--describe`. Run `devmy <command> --describe` to list the variables of its brick before generating.

## Contents

- [Workspace](#workspace)
- [Applications](#applications)
- [Libraries](#libraries)
- [Addons](#addons)
- [Utilities](#utilities)

## Workspace

Run outside any workspace: it creates a new folder named after `--name`.

### `new`

Easily create a Devmy scaffold masterpiece

```bash
devmy new --name <workspace>
```

Addon questions (answer with `--addon`, omit to skip):

- What type of git repository do you want to use? `gitlab`

## Applications

Run inside a workspace. Generates `applications/<name>`.

### `angular`

Generate a fully-equipped Angular project in your workspace

```bash
devmy generate application angular --name <application>
```

Aliases: `devmy g a ng`

Addon questions (answer with `--addon`, omit to skip):

- Which UI component library would you like to integrate into your Angular application? `angular/tailwind`
- Would you like to set up a deploy system? `vercel`

### `nextjs`

Generate a fully-equipped Nextjs project in your workspace

```bash
devmy generate application nextjs --name <application>
```

Aliases: `devmy g a next`

Addon questions (answer with `--addon`, omit to skip):

- Which template would you like to configure for your Next.js project? `next/commerce`
- Which state management solution would you like to use in your Next.js application? `next/zustand`
- Would you like to add a dynamic route to your Next.js application? `next/dynamic-route`
- Would you like to set up a deploy system? `vercel`

### `shopware`

Generate a starter to install Shopware 6, inside the container

```bash
devmy generate application shopware --name <application>
```

### `directus`

Generate a fully-equipped Directus project in your workspace

```bash
devmy generate application directus --name <application>
```

### `nestjs`

Generate a fully-equipped NestJS project in your workspace

```bash
devmy generate application nestjs --name <application>
```

Aliases: `devmy g a nest`

### `cypress`

Generate an armored Cypress project in your workspace

```bash
devmy generate application cypress --name <application>
```

Aliases: `devmy g a cy`, `devmy g a cipresso`

### `firebase`

Generate a solid Firebase project in your workspace

```bash
devmy generate application firebase --name <application>
```

Aliases: `devmy g a fb`

Addon questions (answer with `--addon`, omit to skip):

- Would you like to add some applications to firebase hosting? `firebase/hosting`

## Libraries

Run inside a workspace. Generates `libraries/<name>`.

### `typescript`

Generate a robust typescript library in your workspace

```bash
devmy generate library typescript --name <library>
```

Aliases: `devmy g l ts`

### `angular`

Generate an angular library in your workspace

```bash
devmy generate library angular --name <library>
```

Aliases: `devmy g l ng`

### `cms-connector`

Generate a cms connector library in your workspace

```bash
devmy generate library cms-connector --name <library>
```

Aliases: `devmy g l cmsc`

## Addons

Run inside a workspace. `--target` takes the package.json name of the workspace root, an application or a library. Addons are also offered by the questions of other commands: answer those with `--addon <name>` instead.

### `next/commerce`

Configures the scaffold to support the ecommerce setup in your Next.js project.

```bash
devmy generate addon next/commerce --target <package-name>
```

### `next/zustand`

Integrating Zustand with Next.js

```bash
devmy generate addon next/zustand --target <package-name>
```

### `next/dynamic-route`

Create a dynamic route for your Next.js project

```bash
devmy generate addon next/dynamic-route --target <package-name>
```

### `angular/tailwind`

Integrating TailwindCSS with Angular

```bash
devmy generate addon angular/tailwind --target <package-name>
```

### `gitlab`

Configure Gitlab

```bash
devmy generate addon gitlab --target <package-name>
```

Aliases: `devmy g addon gl`

### `vercel`

Configure Vercel

```bash
devmy generate addon vercel --target <package-name>
```

Aliases: `devmy g addon vercello`, `devmy g addon marcello`

### `firebase/hosting`

Include application to firebase hosting

```bash
devmy generate addon firebase/hosting --target <package-name>
```

## Utilities

Run where the files should be generated.

### `create-brick`

Create new Devmy CLI brick

```bash
devmy utilities create-brick
```
